# Client brief: plain-site.example

Prepared 2026-11-20

Source: https://plain-site.example/

## Business

- **Name:** plain-site.example
- **Website:** plain-site.example

## Offer

No services or products could be read from the navigation or the services page.

## Customers

_Draft avatars. Starting points written from the site, not research. Confirm with the client._

### Draft — The urgent need

- Someone who needs its main service now and has not chosen a business yet.
- Wants: To be seen quickly, to know the price before committing, and to reach a person on the first try.
- Worries about: Being kept waiting, surprise costs, and picking the wrong provider under pressure.
- Searches for: its main service near me · business open now · same day business
- The site has little to reassure this person yet.

### Draft — The careful researcher

- Someone comparing two or three providers before booking its main service.
- Wants: Evidence: reviews, real results, clear pricing, and a sense of who they will be dealing with.
- Worries about: Paying too much, being upsold, and not being able to tell providers apart.
- Searches for: best business · its main service cost · plain-site.example reviews
- The site has little to reassure this person yet.

### Draft — The regular

- An existing customer or a household that wants one dependable business for its main service and everything after.
- Wants: Convenience, continuity, reminders, and fair prices for coming back.
- Worries about: Being treated like a stranger each visit, and awkward booking.
- Searches for: plain-site.example · business its main service · plain-site.example hours
- The site has little to reassure this person yet.

## Competitors

No competitors have been added yet.

## Search presence

No search data yet. Open a Google results page for a focus keyword and it will appear here.

## Issues

_1 page read: /_

No basic on-page issues were found on the pages that were read.

## Next steps

### Recommended

- No customer testimonials were found on the site. Add a few, with names and locations.
- Add LocalBusiness or Organization structured data with name, address, phone and opening hours.
- State the areas served in plain text so people and search engines can see them.
- Consider publishing prices or price ranges; no pricing page was found in the navigation.
- Name two or three competitors so their visibility can be compared with this site.
- Review Google results for the focus keywords to record where the site and its competitors appear.
